title: Expedition 33 Best Pictos - Top Picks & Locations
description: Best Pictos in Expedition 33 ranked by category with locations. Covers Painted Power, AP generators, damage, counter, healing, and Lone Wolf Pictos.

sections.title: What Are Pictos?
sections.content:
Pictos are equippable relics in Expedition 33 that provide two benefits: passive stat boosts (shown at the top of the Pictos card) and a special effect (shown at the bottom). Each character can equip up to 3 Pictos at a time.

The Lumina System

After winning 4 battles with a Pictos equipped, its special effect unlocks as a Lumina. Luminas can then be assigned to ANY character using Lumina Points (earned on level-up). This means you only need to equip a Pictos for 4 fights to permanently unlock its effect for your entire party.

Key Rules

  • Unlocking a Lumina does NOT auto-activate it. You must manually allocate Lumina Points in the menu (click left stick).
  • Only the Lumina effect transfers — not the passive stat boosts. Equipping the Pictos directly still gives both.
  • You can stack multiple Lumina effects on one character, limited only by your Lumina Point total.
  • Stacking the same effect twice on one character is inefficient — spread effects across party members.

Below are the strongest Pictos in the game, organized by function.

sections.title: Damage Limit Removal — Painted Power
sections.content:
Painted Power is the single most important Pictos in the game. It removes the 9,999 damage cap that limits all characters throughout the story. Once obtained, equip it on every character immediately.

PictosEffectLocation
Painted PowerRemoves the 9,999 damage cap entirelyEarned after defeating the final story boss at Monolith Peak

Why It's Mandatory

Before Painted Power, once your characters reach the damage cap, hitting harder becomes meaningless — multi-hit skills are better than single big attacks. After obtaining it, every damage multiplier in the game suddenly becomes relevant. Skills like Sword Ballet and Phantom Stars go from hitting 9,999 to hitting 30,000+ per strike.

This single Pictos transforms the entire endgame. Equip it as a Lumina on all 6 characters as your first priority after the story.

sections.title: Best AP Generators
sections.content:
AP (Action Points) fuel your skills. Having more AP means more abilities per turn, faster Gradient charging, and more damage. These Pictos are the backbone of every strong build.

Energising Start IIMore bonus AP at fight startSanctuary Maze caves — from Expedition 63 Rest Point, right at fork, crouch under gap, right again, climb handholds to dead end
Energising Start IIIEven more bonus AP at fight startLedge at end of path leading out of Esquie's Nest
Energising Start IVMaximum bonus AP at fight startTrench to the right as you enter Forgotten Battlefield combat area
Energising TurnBonus AP each turnEarned after defeating Sirene (Act 2 story boss)
Energising ParryBonus AP on successful ParryEarned after defeating Chromatic Luster in Forgotten Battlefield
Energy MasterSuperior AP generationDefeat Serpenhare near Boat Graveyard (requires Esquie flight)

Priority

Stack all four Energising Start Pictos as Luminas on your main DPS character. Combined with Energising Turn, your damage dealer starts every fight with enough AP for 2-3 skills immediately. Energising Parry is best on characters who Parry frequently (Verso, Maelle with Jarum/Lithum).

sections.content:
These Pictos directly increase damage output. Some have no downside, while others trade survivability for power.

Recommendations

Full Strength and Immaculate are your highest priority — they boost damage with zero risk. Glass Canon is excellent on characters who can reliably Parry/Dodge (Verso at S-Rank). Warming Up shines in long boss fights. First Life and Clea's Death are endgame rewards for Endless Tower mastery.

sections.title: Best Counter Pictos
sections.content:
Successful Parries trigger counterattacks. These Pictos turn those counterattacks into a major damage source, rewarding skilled defensive play.

PictosEffectLocation
Augmented Counter ICounterattack damage boostDefeat Bourgeon southeast of Stone Wave Cliffs on world map
Augmented Counter IIGreater counterattack damage boostDefeat Chromatic Ramasseur in left-most area of Visages (Sadness/Rain)
Augmented Counter IIIMaximum counterattack damage boostDefeat Chromatic Echassier in Lumiere (after returning to defeat Renoir)
Healing CounterCounterattacks restore healthPurchase from Mandelgo merchant in Old Lumiere (20,400 Chroma)

Why Counter Builds Are Strong

With all three Augmented Counter Pictos stacked as Luminas, your Parry counterattacks deal enormous damage — often rivaling dedicated skill damage. Combined with Healing Counter for sustain and Healing Parry for HP restoration, a Parry-focused character becomes nearly self-sufficient: they generate AP, heal themselves, and deal massive damage just by defending.

Best candidates for Counter builds: Maelle (with Jarum/Lithum for automatic Virtuose on counterattack) and Verso (counterattacks build Perfection while dealing amplified S-Rank damage).

Second Chance is insurance against one-shot mechanics in boss fights. Clea's Life provides strong passive regen for characters who take occasional chip damage.

sections.title: Best Lone Wolf Pictos
sections.content:
"Lone Wolf" refers to characters fighting solo — either by choice or because the rest of the party has fallen. These Pictos transform a Last Stand scenario from desperation into a powerful strategy.

PictosEffectLocation
Accelerating Last StandSpeed boost when fighting aloneDefeat Bertrand Big Hands in Hidden Gestral Arena
Empowering Last StandDamage boost when fighting aloneDefeat Julien Tiny Head in Hidden Gestral Arena
Last Stand CriticalCritical rate boost when fighting aloneDefeat Matthieu the Colossus in Hidden Gestral Arena
Protecting Last StandDefense boost when fighting aloneDefeat Dominique Giant Feet in Hidden Gestral Arena
Solo FighterOverall enhancement for solo combatDefeat all 4 opponents in Hidden Gestral Arena

Lone Wolf Strategy

All five Last Stand Pictos come from the Hidden Gestral Arena in Gestral Village at level 15. You must defeat all four arena bosses to unlock Solo Fighter.

With the full set equipped as Luminas, a solo character gets massive boosts to Speed, Damage, Critical Rate, and Defense. This is particularly devastating on Maelle in Virtuose Stance — she already deals maximum damage, and Last Stand multipliers push her into absurd territory.

Use case: Some players intentionally let party members fall to trigger Last Stand bonuses on their strongest character. This is risky but extremely powerful against bosses you can reliably survive solo against.
